description: Import a project's photos into the EZ Reel library (all of them, or the imageIds given; at most 20) and return their assetIds for ez_reel_create. For photos already in a Studio project; for local files use ez_reel_add_photos. Each photo's active edited version (staging, twilight) is the one imported. No upload, no charge.

imageIds.description: Defaults to every photo in the project.

name: ez_reel_import_photos
title: Bring project photos into EZ Reel
